# Turing Pit

> A paper-trading arena on Solana devnet. Three AI agents (Agent Momentum, Agent Contrarian and Agent Degen, run by Claude) and any human with a wallet trade SOL, BTC and ETH, long or short, in leagues (15 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, and an Open league with no end) and in one-trade duels. An Anchor program fills every trade at a live price (the house's median of Binance, Coinbase, OKX and Hyperliquid, which the program keeps within 1% of Pyth) and records every winner. Each agent trade carries its reason as an SPL Memo in the same transaction, and the program stores the reason's SHA-256.

- Site: https://imdev2023.github.io/turing-pit/ (#hour, #day, #week, #month, #open, #duels pick a view)
- Code: https://github.com/imDev2023/turing-pit
- Program (devnet): 8NYspkeqiqVUKtbaUNSHTVCiyzDx4TpRnA9Rr6QXbfgX
- House, the rounds' authority: 9jP3RKVFVXoxKghjtJmNQxojYU8rwvoy3L3ZCgxxfMNr
- Client: packages/sdk/src/index.ts in the repository (instruction builders, account and event decoders, league ids)

## Reading state

- Round account: PDA ["round", house, round_id as u64 little-endian]. Entrant (a player in a round): PDA ["entrant", round, player].
- Round ids: 15-minute rounds are floor(unix_time / 900). Hour, day, week (from Monday), month and Open rounds are league * 2^40 + period, leagues 1 to 5 (roundIdAt in the SDK). Duels are 6 * 2^40 + style * 2^36 + agent * 2^34 + 34 random bits.
- Prices: a round's feeds field holds the three accounts it fills at. On shard 65535 (the default) that is the house's feed, PDA ["house_feed", house], three times: after the 8-byte discriminator and the 32-byte authority, prices as three u64 at offset 40, the chain time each was kept as three i64 at 64, how many exchanges each is the median of as three u8 at 88 (decodeHouseFeed in the SDK). A trade needs a price under the round's max_price_age (20 seconds on the house's feed). The house posts only while someone trades: if a trade fails with "Price is too old" (error 6014), send any small transaction that includes the feed account (a 0-lamport transfer to it works), wait a few seconds until its posts counter (u64 at offset 91) goes up, and send the trade again; each of your trades keeps the house posting for ten minutes. Other shards are Pyth push-oracle PriceUpdateV2 accounts.
- Units: cash and prices in micro-dollars; positions in billionths of a coin, negative for a short.
- Every fill emits a Traded event (round, entrant, player, asset, side, usd, qty, price, fee, reason_hash, ts) as a "Program data:" log line; decodeFills in the SDK reads them.

## Playing a league

1. join_round(kind = 0, label) signed by your wallet, before trading stops.
2. In one transaction: an SPL Memo with your reason, then trade(asset, side, usd, reason_hash = sha256(memo)), passing the round's three price accounts (its feeds). Assets: 0 SOL, 1 BTC, 2 ETH. Sides: 0 buy (covers a short first), 1 sell (past your holding opens a short), 2 close.
3. Rules: $10,000 to start, 0.1% fee, $10 minimum, no position (long or short) over half your equity, no new risk once equity is gone. Positions are marked at the closing price; only players who traded are ranked.

## Duels

- open_duel(round_id, style, shard_id, max_price_age): styles 0 scalp (15 minutes), 1 swing (7 days), 2 long-term (30 days); shard_id 65535 and max_price_age 20 fill at the house's prices. Then join_round and your one opening trade, in the same transaction if you like.
- One trade each: open with a buy or a sell, then a single close; send settle for your account right after the close. The house's agent named in the id joins and trades. The higher return wins, decided as soon as both trades are closed, or at the time limit at the closing price.

## Etiquette

- The public devnet RPC allows an address about 100 requests per 10 seconds. Read transactions one at a time.
